name: Fujiyama Arashi
source:
The sports baka of the game, Arashi is quieter than the usual sports baka. He likes to maintain a cool facade, but his passion shows through while doing Judo. He likes to help others (he's the lifeguard at the pool), and maintains an active lifestyle. He can be a little clueless sometimes.

[From [url=http://tokimekimemorialgs.wikia.com/wiki/Category:Tokimeki_Memorial_Girl%27s_Side_3rd_Story]Tokimeki Memorial Girl's Side Wiki[/url] and [url=http://steflee.wordpress.com/2010/03/02/information-on-tokimeki-memorial-girls-side-3rd-story/]26 Hours[/url]]
